gre_subject.value: ETS offers GRE Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology; no GRE Subject Test exists for Biomedical Engineering.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The Graduate School Admission Guideline for International Students only requires pre-application advisor selection in the application/study plan for Psychology, Cognitive Science, and Integrated Design, and does not state a pre-application supervisor requirement for this department.

funding.value: Students in the Department of Nano Biomedical Engineering receive financial support equivalent to Yonsei University tuition and a monthly stipend through IBS Center for Nanomedicine research funding, plus additional doctoral scholarship support.
funding.quote: Financial support: Students receive financial support equivalent to Yonsei University tuition and a monthly stipend through IBS research funding. Ph.D. and Integrated M.S.-Ph.D. students may also receive additional doctoral scholarship support in accordance with university regulations.

entry_route.value: Yonsei University Graduate School offers both the Integrated Master's-Ph.D. Program (open to applicants holding a Bachelor's degree) and the Ph.D. Program (open to applicants holding a Master's degree) in this department.
entry_route.quote: 1. Eligibility for All Applicants | Master / Integrated Ph. D | w Someone who (will) be awarded a Bachelor’s Degree w Someone who (will) be awarded a Master’s Degree | Science Nano Biomedical Engineering ○ ○ ○

notes: Yonsei offers Ph.D. and Integrated M.S.-Ph.D. degrees in Nano Biomedical Engineering (supported by the IBS Center for Nanomedicine with full tuition and monthly stipend) as well as the Interdisciplinary Program in Biomedical Engineering in the College of Medicine.
